parsed.post: Discarding the recent run (1.0317) as it performed worse than our current best (1.0013). It seems increasing batch size alone didn't yield the expected stability boost. Reverting to commit 241b154. Next, I will try increasing the ASPECT_RATIO to 64 to increase the sequence context/efficiency for the depth 6 architecture.
parsed.description: Increasing ASPECT_RATIO from 48 to 64 to explore if higher sequence resolution/efficiency improves the bits per byte for the depth 6 model.
